minor.issue: Cannot exercise 'escrow not funded' 400 path in regression — no un-funded marketplace response exists in current seed. Test SKIPS gracefully. Main agent can create a response and verify manually.

issues: Escrow-summary card is conditionally rendered only when funded>0 (currently 0), so card not visible in admin account — expected behavior per spec but consider rendering zero-state row with 'No escrow yet' to help discovery.
POST /api/auth/login succeeds but frontend lands on '/' instead of '/dashboard' in some cases — downstream navigation still works because JWT is set. Low-priority routing nit.

critical_code_review_comments: iter7_router.py is 876 lines — borderline large but each concern is clearly sectioned by banner comment; consider splitting kb/, masterdoc/, compliance/, escrow/, ocr/ into sibling modules as it grows.
accept-bid + checkout-status correctly scopes all stripe txn rows by tenant_filter and records metadata (tenant_id, response_id, schedule_activity_id, milestone_pct) — good audit trail.
release-payment correctly gates on escrow_status=='funded' AND milestone_pct when sched_id present — returns 400 with explanatory message.
nist_controls implementation flag is hard-coded True — purely mapping, not a probe. Acceptable for audit reporting but consider active health checks (e.g. ping evidence_endpoint).
verify-chain tolerates missing 'hash' field (rows without hash are treated as having expected hash) — a fresh tenant with rows_examined=0 correctly returns ok=true.
voice-pin exchange redeems a single-use PIN (sets redeemed_at) — good. Consider rate-limiting /auth/voice-pin/exchange to mitigate PIN brute-force (6-digit space = 1M — small).
suggest-polygon centres crop to 60% before LLM call — good token cost control; parses markdown-fenced JSON defensively.

drawing-ocr uses bottom-right 30% crop for title-block + regex heuristics for sheet_number/scale/date/title — sensible defaults but misses atypical title-block placements (top-left). Document assumption.
auto-release hook in tasks_router.py runs via background task on pct_complete change — avoids blocking PATCH; verify failures are logged, not silently dropped.
Stripe Checkout (not Stripe Connect) is called out in agent context — scope reduction documented and acceptable; payout is recorded as ledger entry + notification, not actual Stripe Transfer.

success_rate.backend: 100% functional (21/21 active iter7 + 19/19 active iter6 regression; 2 total conditional skips on gating paths that need specific seed state)

context_for_next_testing_agent: All iter7 endpoints verified end-to-end via /app/backend/tests/test_iteration7.py. Key notes for next agent: (1) GET drawings is at /api/projects/:id/drawings (not /api/drawings); (2) drawings use current_revision_id at top-level (not nested revisions[]); (3) copilot endpoint is /api/ai/copilot with {project_id, message} — not /api/agents/copilot or {question}; (4) recovery apply payload is {suggestion_index: int} — not {chosen_suggestion_index}; (5) voice-pin exchange uses tenant_slug='ice' and returns a JWT with role='voice'; (6) /api/marketplace/escrow-summary returns zeros on fresh tenants with no transactions; (7) WebSocket URL = wss://<host>/api/ws?token=<jwt>, sends 'ping' text (not JSON), receives {kind:'pong'}; (8) polygon suggest can 200/404/500/502 depending on revision storage_path + LLM parse success; (9) OCR passes when the revision's PDF is accessible in storage — pdf2image + pytesseract fully installed and working. Main agent: consider adding a seed/reset endpoint that nukes TEST_* rows + creates 1 un-funded marketplace response so the release-payment gate can be exercised in CI.
